title: Limestone cube erosion study on the Smithsonian roof

tellings.quote: like they they took a one cube of freshly cut limestone and they put it on the roof of the Smithsonian Institution and then began to monitor its erosion over many decades.

plain: Scientists once put a freshly cut cube of limestone on the roof of the Smithsonian Institution and measured how it wore away over many decades, says a researcher named Randall Carlson. He tells Michels about it without naming the study, as a way to show how fast stone weathers, which matters for judging how old ancient stone monuments are.
